caption: The image is of a round decorative plate with a scalloped and ornate edge. The outer rim of the plate features a raised floral design with several large flowers and leaves. The center of the plate depicts a detailed scene with a standing female figure holding a spear, her right foot resting on a male figure who lies on the ground. The female figure is clothed in classical drapery and wears a helmet; the male figure appears to be partially unclothed. There is a crown placed beside the male figure. The background of the central scene includes rolling hills, clouds, and a landscape. Around this central scene is a border with a repeating oval motif. Below the central scene, within the border, the word "VIRGINIA" is clearly inscribed in capital letters. The plate is rendered in monochrome shades, primarily brown and white (or sepia tone), and appears to be photographed or depicted in black and white.
title: Flat Dish - Virginia State Arms
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
